basic_details.job_title: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 13 Technician, Assistant Bacteriologist Posts
basic_details.department: Health Department, Bihar (Bihar Drug Control Laboratory, Technical Cadre)
basic_details.short_information: Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has released two notifications for the Bihar Drug Control Laboratory, Health Department: Advertisement No. 26/2026 for 11 Technician (Bench Chemist) posts and Advertisement No. 25/2026 for 3 Assistant Bacteriologist posts, taking the combined vacancy count to 14. Eligible candidates can apply online at www.btsc.bihar.gov.in from July 24, 2026 to August 23, 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment must be made only in online mode through debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI. Bank charges applicable on the online payment mode will be levied separately by the bank in addition to the application fee. Fee once paid is non-refundable. Candidates applying for both posts must pay the fee separately for each application.

how_to_apply: Locate and click on the online application link for the relevant post - Advertisement No. 26/2026 (Technician Bench Chemist) or Advertisement No. 25/2026 (Assistant Bacteriologist).
Register using a valid, personally accessible mobile number and email ID.
Fill in personal, educational, and category-related details carefully and accurately.
Upload scanned copies of a recent passport-size photograph and all relevant certificates/mark sheets as per specifications.
Pay the application fee of ₹100/- online via debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI.
Review all entries carefully, as corrections after final submission are not permitted.
Submit the application and download/save the confirmation and fee payment receipt for future reference.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out
content_sections.text: Both notifications were issued by the Bihar Technical Service Commission, 19 Harding Road, Patna, on July 22, 2026, on behalf of the Health Department, Bihar. The Technician (Bench Chemist) post falls under the Technician sub-cadre and the Assistant Bacteriologist post falls under the Bacteriologist sub-cadre, both within the technical cadre of the Bihar Drug Control Laboratory. Candidates are advised to read the full notifications carefully before applying, as they contain detailed instructions on eligibility, reservation, and the application process. Official Notification PDF: Technician (Bench Chemist) | Assistant Bacteriologist

content_sections.heading: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 13 vacancies have been announced for Technician (Bench Chemist) and Assistant Bacteriologist posts. Horizontal reservation is applicable to both posts as per Bihar Government norms: 35% reservation for women (Bihar domicile only), reservation for persons with disabilities (PwD categories VH, HH, OH, MH - currently shown as 00 vacancies in each sub-category for both posts), and 2% horizontal reservation for grandchildren of freedom fighters (Bihar domicile, currently 00 vacancies for both posts). The number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on further requisitions received before the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: D.Pharma or B.Pharma from a recognized university. Six (6) months of work experience in drug testing and analysis is mandatory for candidates from both academic qualification categories (D.Pharma as well as B.Pharma). M.D. in Microbiology, or M.Sc. in Microbiology, or M.Pharma from a recognized university. Additional age relaxation of 10 years is admissible to persons with disabilities as per General Administration Department resolution no. 962 dated 22.01.2021. Government servants with three years of continuous regular service get a 5-year age relaxation. Candidates working on contract in non-private laboratories in Bihar (including central/state government, municipal, panchayati raj, and defence laboratories) may get age relaxation equal to the duration of their contractual engagement, up to a maximum limit, calculated as on the 01.08.2026 cut-off. Only one type of age relaxation is admissible to any candidate.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment must be made only in online mode through debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI. Bank charges applicable on the online payment mode will be levied separately by the bank in addition to the application fee. Fee once paid is non-refundable. Candidates applying for both posts must pay the fee separately for each application.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts will be made on the basis of a Computer Based Test (CBT) and work experience, as per the following distribution: The written exam will consist of 100 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 400 marks, in both Hindi and English. Exam duration: 2 hours. 4 marks awarded per correct answer; 1 mark deducted per wrong answer (negative marking applicable). The exam may be conducted in multiple shifts, with results prepared using a normalization process. Minimum qualifying marks: General category – 40%, BC – 36.5%, EBC – 34%, SC/ST/Women/PwD – 32%. Candidates residing outside Bihar (including women and PwD candidates) must secure the General category minimum of 40%. Candidates claiming work experience marks must have qualified the written exam; experience marks are added only after successful document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BTSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process for both Technician (Bench Chemist) and Assistant Bacteriologist posts closes on 23.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in BTSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies in total - 11 for Technician (Bench Chemist) and 3 for Assistant Bacteriologist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for BTSC Technician (Bench Chemist)?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a D.Pharma or B.Pharma from a recognized university, along with six months of work experience in drug testing and analysis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BTSC Assistant Bacteriologist?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.D. in Microbiology, M.Sc. in Microbiology, or M.Pharma from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for both BTSC Technician (Bench Chemist) and Assistant Bacteriologist posts?
faq.answer: Yes, since these are two separate advertisements (26/2026 and 25/2026), eligible candidates meeting the respective qualification and age criteria can apply for both, submitting separate applications and fees for each.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BTSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for all categories for each post, payable online, with additional bank charges as applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for BTSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Technician (Bench Chemist), the minimum age is 21 years; for Assistant Bacteriologist, the minimum age is 25 years. The maximum age ranges from 37 to 42 years depending on category, as on 01.08.2026, for both posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BTSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection for both posts is based on a Computer Based Test (75 marks) and work experience (25 marks), totaling 100 marks.
